Not reachable at runtime. Prototype pollution in mergeIncrementalResult. In src/ui the package is reached only through the @graphql-codegen/* dev tooling (npm ls @graphql-tools/utils), and nothing under src/ui/src imports @graphql-tools, so it never ships in the built bundle. The fixed releases depend on @whatwg-node/promise-helpers@2, which requires Node >=22.15.0, while the UI build pins Node 22.14.0 (.gitlab-ci.yml, the UI CodeBuild project in template.yaml, scripts/sdlc/cfn/codepipeline-s3.yml) and src/ui/.npmrc sets engine-strict=true, so the bump fails npm ci. Revisit when the Node pin moves to 22.15 or later.

Not reachable. The advisory is in the SDK's Agent2Agent (A2A) server (strands.multiagent.a2a), which shares conversation history across callers. This repo never starts an A2A server: nothing imports strands.multiagent.a2a or A2AServer, and the a2a extra is not installed anywhere; every agent here runs in-process inside a Lambda invocation for one caller. The fix (1.43.0) is 29 minor versions past the 1.14.0 pin across idp_common's agent, extraction and discovery extras and nested/multi-doc-discovery, which needs its own upgrade change. Re-check this entry if an A2A server is ever added.

Not reachable. The advisory is in FileSessionManager (strands.session.file_session_manager), whose default storage directory under the system temp dir follows a symbolic link another local user planted there. Only a caller that constructs a session manager reaches it: Agent's session_manager defaults to None and the SDK never creates a FileSessionManager itself, and nothing in this repo imports strands.session or passes session_manager, so no agent here writes session files. The fix (1.48.0) is 34 minor versions past the 1.14.0 pin, the same upgrade GHSA-4v6f-7vjh-6x4m is waiting on. Re-check this entry if a session manager is ever added.
